name: Lyo.Billing
tagline: Professional-services invoicing: charges, draft→issued invoices, and payments that post double-entry journals.
description: Billing documents in schema `billing`, including bill-to clients (`billing.client`). `IBillingStore.IssueInvoiceAsync` snapshots bill-to strings (encrypted tax id) and posts Dr AR / Cr Revenue / Cr Tax. `RecordPaymentAsync` posts Dr Cash / Cr AR. Void writes a reversing journal. This plugin does not render PDFs.
features: `CreateInvoiceFromChargesAsync` builds a draft from unbilled charges.
Copied tax ids and biller bank/remittance use `encrypted_*` bytea columns.

examples.title: Invoice a client and record payment

sections.title: See also
items: [`Lyo.Ledger`](../../Ledger/Lyo.Ledger/README.md). Journals posted at issue and pay.
